statePolicy: Top-level goals.backendStates and backendGoalStates.state describe implementation of the WHOLE requested goal. Essential missing public semantics keep that whole-goal state unimplemented, even when substantial subset code exists. Partial implementations and exact correctness-qualified checkpoints are recorded separately and never imply whole-goal completion. Implemented means the complete stated implementation exists but qualification may remain. Correctness-qualified requires all semantics/failures for its stated scope on stable public builds; performance-qualified additionally requires admitted scale and frozen SLO gates. Capacity-blocked means the fixed declared admission model rejects a stage, not physical impossibility. Native incompatibility is scoped to the evidenced native mode and never silently removes the public requirement.
